functions.name: RGBColorSpaceCompactionTo16Bit
functions.summary: Packs separate R/G/B color channels into a single 16-bit word. When the format selector a1 is 6 the function produces an RGB565 value: red (5 bits from a2), green (6 bits from a3) and blue (5 bits from a4). When a1 is 5 it produces an RGB555 value: red (5 bits from a2), green (5 bits from a3) and blue (5 bits from a4). For any other format selector it returns 0.

operations.description: Initialize result to 0 before any format check.
When the format selector a1 equals 6, take the RGB565 packing path.

RGB565 packing: red occupies the top five bits of a2 (a2 & 0xF8) shifted into bit range 11-15, green occupies six bits of a3 (a3 & 0xFC) shifted into bit range 5-10, and blue occupies the top five bits of a4 ((a4 >> 3) & 0x1F) in bit range 0-4; all OR-merged into the result.
When the format selector a1 equals 5, take the RGB555 packing path.

RGB555 packing: red occupies the top five bits of a2 (a2 & 0xF8) shifted into bit range 10-14, green occupies the top five bits of a3 (a3 & 0xF8) shifted into bit range 5-9, and blue occupies the top five bits of a4 ((a4 >> 3) & 0x1F) in bit range 0-4; all OR-merged into the result.
Return the packed 16-bit color word for supported formats, or 0 when a1 is neither 5 nor 6.

functions.name: ImagePatternedCopy

functions.name: TextureDecodePixelKernel_A

functions.name: sub_5607C1

It stores argument-derived setup values into the dword_5DD8xx globals, computes a word-pointer base into an image buffer, then runs two nested do-while loops (outer = a5 rows, inner = a4 columns). Each inner step reads one 16-bit pixel, rebuilds it through rotation (ROR4) and four byte LUT remaps (byte_5DD8CC, byte_5DDCCC, byte_5DECCC, byte_5E0CCC) with offsets derived from a7 and a8, and writes the transformed word back in place.
